exports.normalizeResolvedSecretInputString: Returns the explicit fixture string; records source path. Secret resolution, configured predicates and ambient credentials are unexecuted.

exports.resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig: Records full source arguments; returns explicit normalized base and Headers(defaultHeaders), without applying transport policy.
exports.fetchWithTimeoutGuarded: Records original POST/GET URL, body, timeout and raw policy provenance; returns a synthetic successful response and counted release. No network or original guarded transport executes.
exports.assertOkOrThrowHttpError: Records successful status/label only; original error handling unexecuted.
exports.readProviderJsonResponse: Returns complete explicit successful JSON payload; original JSON reader unexecuted.
exports.readProviderJsonObjectResponse: Uninvoked throwing binding; source speech uses generic JSON wrapper.
exports.readProviderBinaryResponse: Returns exact opaque fixture bytes; records original deadline callback value and raw cap/callback presence only; original body reader unexecuted.
exports.pollProviderOperationJson: Uninvoked throwing binding; Vydra speech has no polling step.
exports.resolveProviderApiKeyHttpRequestConfig: Uninvoked throwing binding for unrelated shared generation export.
exports.sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest: Uninvoked throwing binding for unrelated shared generation export.

exports.resolveGeneratedMediaMaxBytes: Returns fixed 16777216 audio fixture cap for ordinary cfg={}; cap selection/budget behavior unqualified.
exports.resolveGeneratedImageDownloadMaxBytes: Uninvoked throwing binding for unrelated shared generation export.

exports.rmSync: Uninvoked throwing binding; the complete original speech helper cleanup export is never called.

exports.default: Node platform path module exported unchanged; MIME file-path/sniff functions remain uncalled.

exports.fetch: Uninvoked throwing binding passed to the synthetic guarded transport; no real network executes.
exports.process.env: Fresh plain object containing only the recorded recipe environment; real process environment is not exposed.
exports.Date.now: Constant 1700000000000 per fresh VM, used by original positive operation/deadline helpers. No elapsed-time or timer qualification.
exports.sleepWithAbort: Uninvoked throwing binding; no source speech polling.
exports.executeProviderOperationWithRetry: Uninvoked throwing binding; ordinary POST has no retryStage.
exports.fetchWithTimeout: Uninvoked throwing binding; original postGuardedRequest uses the declared guarded boundary.
exports.createProviderHttpError: Uninvoked throwing binding for unrelated error branches.
exports.isTransientProviderHttpStatus: Uninvoked throwing binding; ordinary source POST has no retryStage.

limits: All58558 pinned tracked blobs/modes verified before and after; whole original source modules, exact source regions, manifest and LICENSE additionally match pinned Git bytes.
Whole-module execution means evaluation, not all exports: original factory/resolveConfig/listVoices/synthesize, normalizeVydraBaseUrl, extractVydraResultUrls and downloadVydraAsset execute.

Original shared operation/deadline/post functions use recorded complete source regions with exact spans/prelude/generated/executable hashes. Original JSON wrapper executes; status/JSON/binary readers and transport are explicit successful synthetic boundaries.

Original MIME/file-name/constants modules execute unchanged after TS erasure. Only extensionForMime/normalization are called; dynamic file-type import/sniffing and unrelated file-path functions are uninvoked.
Source speech has exactly one POST followed by first ordered URL GET, with no polling. Both targets retain the same branch and voiceCompatible=false.

Raw MIME.includes(wav) is case-sensitive, while helper filename extension uses normalized MIME; outputFormat and fileExtension can intentionally diverge. Opaque bytes do not prove codec/transcode/playback.

Every recipe supplies an explicit positive timeout. Original POST passes the explicit per-stage timeout to the synthetic guarded boundary; original download creates its own absolute deadline with constant recorded Date.now. No elapsed-time, fallback/retry/expiration or original guarded transport qualification.

Only recipe process.env is exposed. Source environment config fallback is observed; host configuration/environment policy is not installed. Fixed explicit key normalization is part of synthesis, not authentication or security acceptance.
Manifest is exact source provenance, not an evaluated import or plugin-registration claim. isConfigured/isConfiguredAsync, Talk/telephony/streaming and actual channel delivery are uncalled or absent.
No security/permission/authTLS, negative/error/failure/cancel/crash, mixed, budget/truncation/eviction/threshold/race, real-provider or remote-MCP test executes.
